250: def validate_inputs(args, state, project, helper):
251:     from cti_vla.data.formal_initial_states import load_formal_development_panel
252:     from cti_vla.evaluation import formal_trials as trials, formal_profiling as profiling
253:     evidence = helper.Evidence(project)
254:     # All caller-controlled paths are screened before any JSON/panel loader.
255:     for key in ("execution_manifest", "source_inventory", "freeze_directory", "profile_panel", "prior_review", "collection_review", "repair_record"):
256:         value = getattr(args, key, None)
257:         if value is not None:
258:             local(project, value)
259:             if key not in ("source_inventory",):
260:                 result_relative(value)
261:     inventory, sources = check_source(evidence, helper, args.source_inventory)
262:     registration = helper.registration_contract(evidence, REGISTRATION)
263:     manifest = evidence.read(args.execution_manifest)
264:     suite = manifest.get("suite")
265:     if suite not in registration["suites"] or args.stage not in STAGES:
266:         raise ValueError("Unknown suite/stage")
267:     expected_split = "final" if args.stage == "final" else "development"
268:     if manifest.get("split") != expected_split:
269:         raise ValueError("Stage cannot use another split")
270:     identifiers = trials.validate_execution_manifest(manifest, registration_sha256=signature(registration))
271:     rows = helper.suite_rows(evidence, registration, suite, sources, identifiers)
272:     if manifest["methods"] != rows:
273:         raise ValueError("Manifest method/checkpoint paths differ from completed receipts")
274:     jobs = formal_jobs(state)
275:     acceptance_path = f"results/{ROUND}/{suite}/acceptance/root_review.json"
276:     acceptance = evidence.read(acceptance_path)
277:     gate_job = successful_job(jobs, acceptance["job_id"], mode="acceptance", output=str(P / acceptance["output_relative"]))
278:     if acceptance.get("status") != "passed" or acceptance.get("source_sha256") != FROZEN_SHA256:
279:         raise ValueError("Suite acceptance root review differs from this source")
280:     check_completed_training(evidence, helper, registration, rows, jobs)
281:     proof = source_provenance(evidence, registration=registration, suite=suite,
282:         inventory=inventory, rows=rows, jobs=jobs)
283:     spec = registration["suites"][suite]
284:     development_path = spec["initial_states_root"] + "/development.json"
285:     matrix = release = None
286:     if args.stage in ("final", "full", "components"):
287:         if not args.freeze_directory:
288:             raise ValueError("This stage requires the complete global freeze")
289:         helper.release_global(evidence, registration, args.freeze_directory, release=False)
290:         matrix = evidence.read(args.freeze_directory + "/global_freeze.json")
291:         if args.stage == "final":
292:             release = evidence.read(args.freeze_directory + "/root_release.json")
293:             trials.validate_final_release(release, matrix, registration_sha256=signature(registration))
294:             if manifest != helper.make_execution(registration, suite, rows, split="final", matrix=matrix, release=release):
295:                 raise ValueError("Final manifest is not the exact released matrix")
296:         elif manifest.get("global_freeze") is not None or manifest.get("release") is not None:
297:             raise ValueError("Profiling must use development manifest identity")
298:     elif args.freeze_directory is not None:
299:         raise ValueError("An unrelated global freeze cannot change this stage")
300:     if args.stage != "final":
301:         evidence.watch(development_path)
302:         development = load_formal_development_panel(evidence.path(development_path))
303:         if development["suite"] != suite:
304:             raise ValueError("Wrong registered development panel")
305:         if "development_panel" in manifest and (manifest["development_panel"] != development_path
306:                 or manifest.get("development_panel_sha256") != evidence.watch(development_path)):
307:             raise ValueError("Development manifest panel changed")
308:     else:
309:         # Final state values are never opened here, even after release. The
310:         # original server loader owns that operation after rechecking release.
311:         development = None
312:     panel_artifacts = {}
313:     if args.stage in ("collect", "full", "components"):
314:         profiling.validate_profile_manifest(manifest, registration, collect=args.stage == "collect", global_freeze=matrix)
315:         if args.stage == "collect":
316:             if args.profile_panel is not None or args.collection_review is not None:
317:                 raise ValueError("Collection cannot substitute an existing observation panel")
318:         else:
319:             if not args.profile_panel or not args.collection_review:
320:                 raise ValueError("Timing requires the original audited collection panel")

438: def prior_contract(args, state, validated, project):
439:     evidence, stage, suite, methods = validated["evidence"], args.stage, validated["suite"], validated["methods"]
440:     jobs = formal_jobs(state)
441:     tag = signature(methods)[:16]
442:     stage_key = f"{suite}_{stage}_{tag}"
443:     prior = [j for j in jobs if j.get("mode") == stage and j.get("suite") == suite
444:              and (not j.get("method_ids") or set(j["method_ids"]) & set(methods))]
445:     if any(j.get("stage_key") != stage_key or j.get("method_ids") != methods for j in prior):
446:         raise ValueError("Another registered stage overlaps these method/state instances")
447:     if any(j.get("status") not in TERMINAL for j in prior):
448:         raise ValueError("This downstream stage already has an active or unresolved job")
449:     for job in prior:
450:         if (type(job.get("elapsed_seconds")) is not int or job["elapsed_seconds"] < 0 or job.get("gpus") != 1
451:                 or job.get("source_sha256") != FROZEN_SHA256 or job.get("adapter_sha256") != ADAPTER_SHA256):
452:             raise ValueError("Every prior allocation must retain its source and complete GPU cost")
453:     prior.sort(key=lambda j: (j.get("submitted_utc", ""), int(j["job_id"])))
454:     base = f"results/{ROUND}/{suite}/downstream/{stage}/{tag}"
455:     output = result_relative(args.output_relative or (PurePosixPath(prior[-1]["run_root"]).relative_to(P).as_posix()
456:         if prior and stage in ("development", "final") else f"{base}/attempt{len(prior)+1:02d}"))
457:     if PurePosixPath(base) not in PurePosixPath(output).parents:
458:         raise ValueError("Output differs from this registered stage identity")
459:     review = None
460:     if prior:
461:         if not args.prior_review:
462:             raise ValueError("Newest terminal attempt requires its root audit and stable SHA pull")
463:         review = require_root_review(evidence, args.prior_review, jobs, expected_stage=stage)
464:         if review["job_id"] != prior[-1]["job_id"]:
465:             raise ValueError("Only the newest terminal attempt can authorize continuation")
466:         if review["scientific_complete"]:
467:             raise ValueError("This downstream stage is already scientifically completed")
468:         if review["execution_manifest_sha256"] != evidence.watch(args.execution_manifest):
469:             raise ValueError("Continuation cannot change its manifest/checkpoint identities")
470:         if stage in ("development", "final"):
471:             if not args.resume or str(P / output) != prior[-1]["run_root"]:
472:                 raise ValueError("Existing rollouts require explicit resume of the same output")
473:             from cti_vla.evaluation import formal_trials
474:             adapter = load(ADAPTER, project)
475:             config = evidence.read(output + "/config.json")
476:             if (config.get("manifest") != validated["manifest"] or config.get("source_files") != validated["sources"]
477:                     or config.get("registration_sha256") != signature(validated["registration"])
478:                     or config.get("schema") != ROUND or config.get("kind") != "evaluation_run"
479:                     or config.get("policy_watchdog_seconds") != 60.):
480:                 raise ValueError("Resume run config has another frozen identity")
481:             panel = validated["development"]
482:             if stage == "final":
483:                 # A registry holds only identifiers/hashes, sufficient for the
484:                 # raw trial validator. Never read the output's final panel.
485:                 spec = validated["registration"]["suites"][suite]
486:                 registry_path = spec["initial_states_root"] + "/final_registry.json"

168: def source_snapshot_jobs(evidence, registration, suite, method_rows=()):
169:     """Use original terminal root snapshots; never read mutable supervisor state."""
170:     saved = evidence.read(f"results/{SCHEMA}/{suite}/acceptance/root_review.json")
171:     jobs = [saved.get("job_at_review")]
172:     wanted = {(r["identity"]["visual_tokens"], r["identity"]["training_seed"])
173:         for r in method_rows if r["identity"]["method"] in ("A", "B")}
174:     for pair in registration["pairs"]:
175:         if pair["suite"] != suite or (pair["visual_tokens"], pair["seed"]) not in wanted:
176:             continue
177:         directory = pair_directory(evidence, pair)
178:         summary = evidence.read(directory / "training_summary.json")
179:         final = evidence.read(directory / "segment_reviews" / (str(summary.get("job_id")) + ".json"))
180:         history = final.get("registered_pair_jobs_at_review")
181:         if not isinstance(history, list) or not history:
182:             raise ValueError("Completed5000 training requires its immutable full job history")
183:         jobs.extend(history)
184:     by_id = {}
185:     for job in jobs:
186:         if not isinstance(job, dict) or not str(job.get("job_id", "")).isdigit():
187:             raise ValueError("Original root source audit lacks a registered job snapshot")
188:         key = str(job["job_id"])
189:         if key in by_id and by_id[key] != job:
190:             raise ValueError("Conflicting immutable source job snapshots")
191:         by_id[key] = job
192:     return [by_id[key] for key in sorted(by_id, key=int)]

195: def source_provenance_for_rows(evidence, registration, suite, rows, *, inventory=None, jobs=None):
196:     auditor = source_review_module(evidence)
197:     inventory = evidence.read(SOURCE_INVENTORY) if inventory is None else inventory
198:     jobs = source_snapshot_jobs(evidence, registration, suite, rows) if jobs is None else jobs
199:     proof = auditor.review_source_provenance(evidence, registration=registration, suite=suite,
200:         inventory=inventory, method_rows=rows, jobs=jobs)
201:     evidence.source_provenance[suite] = proof
202:     return proof

250: def _pair_source(evidence, *, suite, pair, method_rows, jobs, inventory, accepted):
251:     from cti_vla.evaluation.formal_runtime import formal_metadata, validate_formal_receipt
252:     from cti_vla.evaluation.formal_trials import selector_instance_identity
253:     from cti_vla.evaluation.teacher_diagnostics import json_signature
254:     base = PurePosixPath(pair["run_root_server"]).relative_to(P).as_posix() + "/training"
255:     config = evidence.read(pair["path"])
256:     require(evidence.watch(pair["path"]) == pair["sha256"] and evidence.read(base + "/registered_config.json") == config,
257:         "training configuration differs from registration")
258:     summary = evidence.read(base + "/training_summary.json")
259:     same(summary, dict(schema=SCHEMA, status="completed", pair_complete=True, planned_updates_per_arm=5000,
260:         checkpoint_unchanged=True, test_opened=False), "complete5000 training summary")
261:     review_path = base + "/segment_reviews/" + str(summary.get("job_id")) + ".json"
262:     saved = evidence.read(review_path)
263:     same(saved, dict(schema=SCHEMA, kind="root_segment_review", status="passed", suite=suite,
264:         visual_tokens=pair["visual_tokens"], seed=pair["seed"], source_sha256=SOURCE_SHA256,
265:         output_relative=base, job_id=summary["job_id"], requested_segment_end=5000, completed_by_arm={"A":5000,"B":5000},
266:         ab_same_registered_boundary=True, resume_required=False, continuation="formal_training_complete_no_extension"), "final segment review")
267:     relevant = [j for j in jobs if j.get("experiment") == SCHEMA and j.get("mode") == "train" and j.get("run_root") == str(P / base)]
268:     snapshots = saved.get("registered_pair_jobs_at_review", [])
269:     require(relevant and len({j["job_id"] for j in relevant}) == len(relevant)
270:         and {j["job_id"]:job_identity(j) for j in relevant} == {j["job_id"]:job_identity(j) for j in snapshots}
271:         and len(snapshots) == len(relevant), "final segment omitted or changed registered training allocations")
272:     ids = {j["job_id"] for j in relevant}
273:     if suite in SUITES:
274:         require(set(saved.get("runtime_compatibility_history", {})) == ids, "metadata history does not cover every allocation")
275:     else:
276:         require(not any(k in saved for k in ("runtime_compatibility", "runtime_compatibility_review", "runtime_compatibility_history")),
277:             "legacy training cannot carry metadata compatibility fields")
278:     if suite == "libero_goal":
279:         require(set(saved.get("component_compatibility_history", {})) == ids, "Goal component history does not cover every allocation")
280:     else:
281:         require(not any(k in saved for k in ("component_compatibility", "component_compatibility_review", "component_compatibility_history")),
282:             "Object training cannot carry Goal fields")
283:     files = saved.get("files", {})
284:     require(base + "/training_summary.json" in files, "final segment omits final summary")
285:     immutable_file_map(evidence, files)
286:     last_job = registered_job(jobs,summary["job_id"],suite=suite,mode="train",output=base)
287:     _root_pull(evidence,saved=saved,job=last_job,shared=accepted["shared"],required=list(files))
288:     for job in relevant:
289:         registered_job(jobs, job["job_id"], suite=suite, mode="train", output=base)
290:         require(job.get("training_seed") == pair["seed"] and job.get("visual_tokens") == pair["visual_tokens"],
291:             "training history changes pair")
292:         require(evidence.watch(job["invocation"]) == job["invocation_sha256"], "historical training invocation changed")
293:         inv = evidence.read(job["invocation"])
294:         require(inv.get("stage") == "train" and inv.get("stage_key") == job["stage_key"], "historical stage contract differs")
295:         proxy = (dict(runtime_compatibility=saved["runtime_compatibility"],
296:             runtime_compatibility_review=saved["runtime_compatibility_history"][job["job_id"]]) if suite in SUITES else {})
297:         runtime = accepted["shared"].require_saved_runtime_review(evidence, saved=proxy, job=job, inventory=inventory)
298:         require((runtime is not None) == (suite in SUITES), "training metadata proof missing")
299:         if runtime:
300:             require(runtime["runtime_compatibility"] == accepted["runtime"]["runtime_compatibility"], "training metadata source differs from acceptance")
301:         if suite == "libero_goal":
302:             proxy.update(component_compatibility=saved["component_compatibility"],
303:                 component_compatibility_review=saved["component_compatibility_history"][job["job_id"]])
304:         goal = accepted["shared"].require_saved_component_review(evidence, saved=proxy, job=job, inventory=inventory, metadata_review=runtime)
305:         require((goal is not None) == (suite == "libero_goal"), "training component proof missing")
306:         if goal:
307:             require(goal["component_compatibility"] == accepted["component"]["component_compatibility"], "training component source differs from acceptance")
308:         if job["job_id"] == summary["job_id"]:
309:             require(saved.get("runtime_compatibility_review") == runtime, "latest metadata proof differs from history")
310:             require(saved.get("component_compatibility_review") == goal, "latest component proof differs from history")
311:     require(saved.get("pair_allocated_gpu_seconds") == sum(j["elapsed_seconds"] * j["gpus"] for j in relevant),
312:         "source training allocation costs differ")
313:     bindings = {}
314:     for row in method_rows:
315:         identity = row["identity"]; arm = identity["method"]
316:         receipt_path = base + "/" + arm + "/deployment_receipt.json"
317:         report_path = base + "/" + arm + "/training_report.json"
318:         require(row.get("receipt") == receipt_path and row.get("pair_config") == pair["path"], "method points to another training source")
319:         require(receipt_path in files and report_path in files, "final segment does not bind selected deployment/report")
320:         receipt, report = evidence.read(receipt_path), evidence.read(report_path)
321:         metadata = formal_metadata(receipt["metadata"])
322:         validate_formal_receipt(receipt, metadata)
323:         accepted_f01 = accepted["saved"]["output_relative"] + f"/f01_k{pair['visual_tokens']}.json"
324:         require(row.get("f01_report") == accepted_f01
325:             and receipt["f01_report_sha256"] == evidence.watch(accepted_f01)
326:             and metadata["input_acceptance_sha256"] == accepted["projection"]["input_acceptance_sha256"]
327:             and metadata["training_source_files"] == accepted["sources"], "selected receipt uses another acceptance/source")
328:         reconstructed = selector_instance_identity({**metadata, "selector_checkpoint_sha256":receipt["checkpoint_sha256"],
329:             "deployment_receipt_sha256":json_signature(receipt), "f01_report_sha256":receipt["f01_report_sha256"]})
330:         require(identity == reconstructed and receipt.get("pair_config") == config, "selected scientific identity differs")
331:         same(report, dict(status="completed", training_updates_completed=5000, next_sample_cursor=40000,
332:             committed_samples=40000, best_checkpoint_sha256=identity["checkpoint_sha256"],
333:             evaluations=receipt["evaluations"], vla_parameters_unchanged=True), "complete arm report")
334:         require(summary.get("arms", {}).get(arm) == report and [x.get("update") for x in receipt["evaluations"]] == list(range(0,5001,500)),
335:             "all11 selected validation nodes must be retained")
336:         expected_checkpoint = str(PurePosixPath(pair["checkpoint_root_server"]) / arm / "best.pt")
337:         require(row.get("checkpoint") == expected_checkpoint and report.get("best_checkpoint") == expected_checkpoint,
338:             "deployment checkpoint path differs")
339:         bindings[identity["method_id"]] = dict(suite=suite, method_id=identity["method_id"], identity=identity,
340:             segment_review=dict(path=review_path, sha256=evidence.watch(review_path)),
341:             deployment_receipt=dict(path=receipt_path, sha256=evidence.watch(receipt_path)),
342:             training_report=dict(path=report_path, sha256=evidence.watch(report_path)),
343:             registered_training_job_ids=sorted(ids, key=int))
344:     return bindings, [job_identity(j) for j in relevant]

63: def _no_exception_claims(value):
64:     # False/null bookkeeping is not an approval. No positive or unknown claim,
65:     # even one carrying a path/SHA, is a supported equivalence exception here.
66:     require(type(value) is dict, "Historical metadata must be a mapping")
67:     for key, item in value.items():
68:         if "equivalence" in key.lower() or "resolution" in key.lower() or "separate_treatment" in key.lower():
69:             require(item is False or item is None,
70:                 "Unsupported historical-equivalence/handling claim; separately registered protocol required")

73: def _require_current_ancestry(evidence, base, reference, rebuilt, *, suite):
74:     """Called only after the unchanged consumer reconstructs the current root.
75: 
76:     Ancestors are immutable SHA-bound receipt metadata, not re-reviews of mutable
77:     old output directories. The current raw reviewer already verifies the actual
78:     preserved byte prefix. We never relabel historical rows as current execution.
79:     """
80:     require(suite in SUITES, "Unknown suite")
81:     saved = _read_ref(evidence, base, reference)
82:     omit_time = lambda value: {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "reviewed_utc"}
83:     require(omit_time(saved) == omit_time(rebuilt), "Current report is not the consumed immutable root")
84:     seen = set(); chain = []; report = saved; current_ref = reference
85:     expected_semantics = rebuilt.get("action_semantics_sha256")
86:     expected_root = rebuilt.get("run_root"); expected_stage = rebuilt.get("stage_key")
87:     expected_manifest = rebuilt.get("execution_manifest_sha256")
88:     while True:
89:         base.ref(current_ref)
90:         require(current_ref["path"] not in seen, "Cyclic historical development chain")
91:         seen.add(current_ref["path"])
92:         _no_exception_claims(report)
93:         require(report.get("execution_version", OLD_VERSION) == EXECUTION_VERSION,
94:             "Unresolved legacy execution in development ancestry; current top-level version is insufficient")
95:         require(report.get("schema") == "formal_main_v2" and report.get("kind") == "root_downstream_review"
96:             and report.get("status") == "passed" and report.get("reviewed_by") == "root"
97:             and report.get("stage") == "development" and report.get("suite") == suite,
98:             "Historical root is not a matching development receipt")
99:         require(report.get("run_root") == expected_root and report.get("stage_key") == expected_stage
100:             and report.get("execution_manifest_sha256") == expected_manifest,
101:             "Historical development identity changed")
102:         require("historical_transition" in report, "Historical-transition marker is missing")
103:         require(type(report.get("scientific_complete")) is bool, "Historical completion scope is missing")
104:         base.sha(expected_semantics)
105:         require(report.get("action_semantics_sha256") == expected_semantics, "Historical action semantics differ")
106:         inv_ref = report.get("invocation_ref")
107:         invocation = _read_ref(evidence, base, inv_ref)
108:         require(inv_ref["path"].startswith("results/formal_main_v2/invocations/")
109:             and report.get("invocation") == inv_ref["path"] and report.get("invocation_sha256") == inv_ref["sha256"],
110:             "Historical invocation reference differs")
111:         require(invocation.get("schema") == "formal_main_v2" and invocation.get("kind") == "formal_downstream_invocation"
112:             and invocation.get("version") == EXECUTION_VERSION and invocation.get("stage") == "development"
113:             and invocation.get("suite") == suite and invocation.get("run_root") == expected_root
114:             and invocation.get("stage_key") == expected_stage
115:             and invocation.get("execution_manifest_sha256") == expected_manifest,
116:             "Historical invocation identity changed")
117:         _no_exception_claims(invocation)
118:         contract_ref = report.get("action_execution_contract")
119:         require(invocation.get("action_execution_contract") == contract_ref, "Historical runtime contract reference differs")
120:         contract = _read_ref(evidence, base, contract_ref)
121:         _no_exception_claims(contract)
122:         require(contract.get("version") == EXECUTION_VERSION
123:             and all(contract.get("files", {}).get(name) == checksum for name, checksum in UPSTREAM_SHA.items())
124:             and base.semantic_identity(contract) == expected_semantics, "Historical runtime source/semantic binding differs")
125:         chain.append({"root_review": dict(current_ref), "invocation": dict(inv_ref), "action_execution_contract": dict(contract_ref)})
126:         resume = invocation.get("resume")
127:         require(type(resume) is bool, "Explicit historical resume state required")
128:         historical = report["historical_transition"]
129:         if not resume:
130:             require(historical is None and contract.get("transition") is None
131:                 and invocation.get("prior_review") is None and invocation.get("prior_job_ids") == [],
132:                 "Fresh execution has hidden or contradictory ancestry")
133:             break
134:         require(type(historical) is dict and historical.get("reference") == contract.get("transition"),
135:             "Resume lost its exact historical transition reference")
136:         _no_exception_claims(historical)
137:         transition = _read_ref(evidence, base, contract["transition"])
138:         _no_exception_claims(transition)
139:         require(transition.get("schema") == "formal_main_v2" and transition.get("kind") == "formal_action_runtime_transition"
140:             and transition.get("status") == "root_reviewed" and transition.get("to_version") == EXECUTION_VERSION
141:             and transition.get("run_root") == expected_root and transition.get("stage_key") == expected_stage
142:             and transition.get("execution_manifest_sha256") == expected_manifest,
143:             "Historical transition identity differs")
144:         require(transition.get("terminal_trials_repeated") is False and transition.get("prior_outcomes_replaced") is False
145:             and transition.get("new_trial_ids_only") is True and historical.get("historical_terminal_outcomes_replaced") is False,
146:             "Historical outcomes cannot be replaced or replayed")
147:         prior_path = invocation.get("prior_review")
148:         require(isinstance(prior_path, str) and prior_path.startswith("results/formal_main_v2/downstream_reviews/")
149:             and transition.get("prior_review") == prior_path
150:             and transition.get("prior_job_ids") == invocation.get("prior_job_ids"), "Historical prior-review binding differs")
151:         prior_ref = {"path": prior_path, "sha256": invocation.get("root_evidence_sha256", {}).get(prior_path)}
152:         prior = _read_ref(evidence, base, prior_ref)
153:         prior_version = prior.get("execution_version", OLD_VERSION)
154:         require(historical.get("from_version") == transition.get("from_version") == prior_version,
155:             "Historical transition conceals its actual prior version")
156:         prefix_sha = historical.get("preserved_prefix_sha256"); base.sha(prefix_sha)
157:         require(type(historical.get("preserved_prefix_bytes")) is int and historical["preserved_prefix_bytes"] > 0,
158:             "Historical byte-prefix extent is missing")
159:         output = base.remote_relative(expected_root)
160:         files = transition.get("files", {})
161:         require(type(files) is dict and {output + "/" + n for n in ("trials.jsonl", "closed_loop_report.json", "config.json", "panel.json")} <= set(files),
162:             "Historical transition omits original prefix/config/panel")
163:         require(files.get(output + "/trials.jsonl") == prefix_sha
164:             and all(prior.get("files", {}).get(name) == checksum for name, checksum in files.items()),
165:             "Historical prefix is not bound to the prior immutable review")
